tm_config.hardware: Full-scale TM inference FlexIC in Pragmatic's 600 nm IGZO thin-film process (unipolar logic, two metal layers), 8x8 mm2 die at ~10% placement density, ~6800 NAND2-eq gates; 64-bit input, 4-bit class index output; 4-stage pipeline (input regs, clause logic + adder tree, ArgMax, output regs); Verilog, Cadence Genus synthesis, Innovus P&R, Calibre DRC/LVS. Power/energy are post-synthesis estimates over a clock-period sweep (acceptable slack from 5 us); energy minimum at ~7 us. Not measured on silicon.

tm_config.hardware: Compact TM inference FlexIC in Pragmatic's 600 nm IGZO process, 4x4 mm2 die, ~1420 NAND2-eq gates (559 included TAs); same 4-stage pipeline. Post-synthesis: 1480 gates / 1.8 mW at 4 us clock-period constraint, 1290 gates / 1.3 mW at 15 us; power mostly static (pull-up resistors). Latency: output 3 clock cycles after input in RTL simulation; post-layout parasitic simulation worst-case propagation delay ~1.5 us at 100 kHz clock. Not measured on silicon.

corrections.note: Die sizes are stated in II-C 'Physical Implementation' (and the abstract); II-B is 'Design'.

notes: Hardware paper: two hard-wired TM inference FlexICs designed (synthesis, P&R, DRC/LVS, post-layout simulation); no fabricated-chip measurements are reported. All accuracies are software validation accuracies of the trained models; the paper never reports a test set or split sizes, and the reported accuracies are the best seed out of many on that validation data. Energy per inference (results 2, 3) exists only in Fig. 9 and could not be checked from text. Full-model power/area values are only in Figs. 6-8. Weighting is unclear: Fig. 1 shows +1/-1 clause polarities, but Sec. II-A mentions 'weight updates of the clause'; left not_reported. Training library not named. Internal inconsistency: Sec. II-B describes a four-stage pipeline, the Conclusion a 'three-stage pipelined RTL architecture' (latency is 3 clock cycles). The text also loosely calls the dataset 'MNIST' (Sec. I).
